summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting minutes of its Fiscal Council meeting held August 12, 2026. The Council unanimously approved a proposal to declare Interest on Capital (IoC), a Brazilian equivalent of a dividend, in the gross amount of R$350,000,000 (R$288,750,000 net of 17.5% withholding tax), based on the July 31, 2026 balance sheet. The gross IoC per share is R$0.10952537999, with R$0.09035843849 net. The record date is August 26, 2026, after which shares trade ex-IoC. Payment will occur by April 30, 2027, with the amount allocated to the mandatory minimum dividend for FY2026. The proposal requires Board of Directors approval and Ordinary General Meeting ratification in 2027. Watch for final Board approval and potential per-share adjustments due to the ongoing share buyback program affecting the share count at the record date.
